annotations.title: Track brand visibility in AI answers

description: Check whether AI answers name and cite a brand for the questions its buyers ask. Give brand_name, brand_domain, and questions (for example "best crm for small business"). Each question is asked samples times (default 3) on each engine: google_ai_overview needs no key; openai (ChatGPT), anthropic (Claude), perplexity, and gemini run on the caller's own API keys, which this server reads from its environment (OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, PERPLEXITY_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY). Returns one sample row per answer (brand_named, brand_cited, first_mention_rank, competitors_named, cited_domains, answer_excerpt), one question_summary row per question and engine (brand_named_rate, brand_cited_rate with a 95 percent range, top_cited_domains, competitor rates), and one free brand_summary row per engine. Bad input returns one free row whose error_reason starts with input_invalid. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN; Apify charges per Google sample, per engine sample, and per question rates row.

anthropic_model.description: Model for the anthropic engine. Default claude-sonnet-5-5.

brand_aliases.description: Other ways answers write the brand, such as a product name. Up to 10.

brand_domain.description: The brand website domain, such as hubspot.com. An answer that cites a page on it, or on a subdomain, counts as cited.

brand_name.description: The brand to look for in the answers, as people write it, for example HubSpot. Matched as a whole word, any case.

competitors.description: Up to 20 competitors to track in the same answers, as a name, a domain, or name|domain (Pipedrive|pipedrive.com).

country.description: Two letter country code for Google, such as us or gb. Default us.

engines.description: Where to ask. Default google_ai_overview only. openai, anthropic, perplexity, and gemini need that vendor's API key in this server's environment; the model use is billed to the key owner by the vendor.

gemini_model.description: Model for the gemini engine. Default gemini-2.5-flash.

include_answer_text.description: true (default) returns the answer text up to 8,000 characters on each sample row; false returns the 300 character excerpt only.

language.description: Language code for Google, such as en or de. Default en.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before it would charge more than this.

openai_model.description: Model for the openai engine. Default gpt-5-mini.

perplexity_model.description: Model for the perplexity engine. Default sonar.

questions.description: 1 to 50 questions buyers ask, written the way they would type them, for example best crm for small business.

samples.description: How many times each question is asked on each engine, 1 to 10. Default 3.

name: track_ai_answer_visibility
title: Track brand visibility in AI answers
